extracted.intended_audience: media professionals and content creators covering CES (press, broadcasters, online journalists, photographers)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical resources and procedural requirements for media professionals covering CES, including on-site benefits, registration/badge rules, media-day access, logistics, safety, and available assets. Focused on helping accredited media plan, operate, and file coverage at the event.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact the CES Communications team with any media inquiries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CES provides a dedicated communications team to handle press questions; media should use the listed contact method for official responses and coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Photos
rubrics_metrics.description: CES provides high-quality show images that you can use in your coverage of the event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official CES photos are available for media use — check the Media Photos resource for image assets and any usage guidelines or attribution requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: On-Site Media Rooms (Benefits, Hours and Locations)
rubrics_metrics.description: CES Media Rooms provide a quiet area for registered media to work, conduct interviews, and file reports without distractions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media Rooms are an on-site benefit; consult hours and locations to plan interviews, filing, and workspace needs during the show.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Days Access
rubrics_metrics.description: Media Days are open exclusively to registered media and will feature leading tech brands making product announcements before the show floor opens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only registered media can attend Media Days; plan registration and scheduling to attend pre-show announcements and briefings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation Guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Find out how to get around the show and the city of Las Vegas during CES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media should review transportation options and plan routes/timelines between venues, Media Rooms, and remote badge pickup locations to manage coverage schedules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Badge Pickup Requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All show attendees, including media and individual exhibitor personnel, must pick up their own CES 2026 official badge at a remote badge pickup location.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Badges are required for access; plan to pick up your own badge during posted pickup hours and follow any identification or verification procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel Tips and Discounts
rubrics_metrics.description: Find discounts on flights, car rental and entertainment in Las Vegas during CES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media can take advantage of negotiated discounts and travel tips to reduce costs and streamline logistics; check the Planning and Support resources for current offers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration Information and Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about pricing, requirements and guidelines for CES registration and passes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review registration categories, eligibility rules for press credentials, pricing, and any documentation required to obtain media credentials prior to arrival.

rubrics_metrics.name: On-Site Services (ADA, Business Center, Coat/Bag Check, Emergency Numbers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn about the ADA services, business center, coat and bag check, security and emergency numbers at CES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Familiarize yourself with available on-site services (including accessibility accommodations) and emergency contact information to ensure smooth operations and safety while covering the show.

rubrics_metrics.name: Safety & Security Measures
rubrics_metrics.description: CES continues to implement enhanced security measures; learn what you can expect and should prepare for as you plan your CES experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media should prepare for heightened security protocols, follow instructions from show security, and plan equipment/credentialing accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Health Protocols and Best Practices
rubrics_metrics.description: To stay healthy while you're at the show, please take note of important safety information and a few best practices as you plan your trip to CES 2027.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow posted health protocols and recommended best practices (e.g., hygiene, illness policies) to protect yourself and sources; check updates prior to travel as protocols may change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Opportunities (Exclusive Offerings to Enhance Coverage)
rubrics_metrics.description: The media hub provides an array of exclusive opportunities designed to enhance your coverage and streamline your experience at this cutting-edge event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore listed media opportunities to identify briefings, interviews, and press-only events that can add value to coverage; coordinate with communications team and exhibitors as needed.
